79918756.title: Danielle St James
79918756.extract: Danielle Zoah Anson-Jones (née Gibbison; born 18 April 1992), known professionally as Danielle or Dani St James, is a Welsh model, entrepreneur and campaigner.

84016543.title: Kunda Mwamulima
84016543.extract: Kunda Mwamulima is a Zambian nurse, model and beauty pageant titleholder. She was crowned Miss Universe Zambia 2025 and Miss Earth Zambia 2023.

45719578.title: Jeon Soo-jin
45719578.extract: Jeon Soo-jin (born November 8, 1988) is a South Korean actress. Born in Seoul but raised in Jeju Island, she was studying design at Konkuk University in 2008 when she began doing part-time work as a model for the fashion magazines Shibuya and CeCi.
